cards.name: Overall Shipping KPI
cards.sql:
with base as
(
SELECT 
	identifiers_sessionid,
	MAX(case when action = 'PageView' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' then 1 else 0 end) AS shipping_page,
	MAX(case when action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping'  then 1 else 0 end) AS shipping_submitted
FROM 
	eshop_data.es_events_v2 
WHERE 
	{{Date}}
  	AND nc = 'de'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(identifiers_page_category_2) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
		AND ('All' IN ({{category}}) 
         OR category = {{category}}
         or LOWER(category) = {{category}})
        AND lower(internalemployee) = 'no'
        AND lower(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
	AND {{osname}} 
GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT	
	COUNT(CASE WHEN shipping_page =  1 then identifiers_sessionid end) as shipping_page,
	COUNT(CASE WHEN shipping_submitted =  1 then identifiers_sessionid end) as shipping_page_submitted,
	COUNT(CASE WHEN shipping_submitted =  1 then identifiers_sessionid end)*1.0/COUNT(CASE WHEN shipping_page =  1 then identifiers_sessionid end) as perc
FROM
	base

with base as
(
SELECT 
	date,
	identifiers_sessionid,
	action,
	label,
	identifiers_page_name,
	attr_error_type,
	event_type,
	attr_error_code,
	attr_error_description,
	row_number() over(partition by identifiers_sessionid order by identifiers_log_time DESC) as rn
FROM 
	eshop_data.es_events_v2 
WHERE 
	{{Date}}
  	AND nc = 'de'
    AND category <> 'addonManagement'
	AND service_line = 'fixed'
	AND internalemployee = 'no'
	AND  {{category}}
	AND {{osname}} 
)
,final_base as
(
SELECT
	attr_error_type,
	attr_error_code,
	attr_error_description,
	identifiers_sessionid
FROM
	base
WHERE
	identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping'
  and attr_error_type <> 'warning + confirmation'
  and event_type = 'debug'
  and rn <= 3
)
,success as
(
SELECT
	date,
	identifiers_sessionid	
FROM
	base
WHERE
	identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping'
  and action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted'

	count(DISTINCT a.identifiers_sessionid) as last_error_sessions,

	count(distinct case when l.identifiers_sessionid is not null then a.identifiers_sessionid end) as session_with_step_completed
FROM
	final_base a
LEFT JOIN success l on a.identifiers_sessionid = l.identifiers_sessionid

cards.name: Shipping Flow (Drop off Analysis)
cards.sql:
WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    identifiers_sessionid,
    identifiers_log_time,
	identifiers_page_name,
 	action,
	label,
	attr_option_selected,
	attr_elementtitle,
    LEAD(action) OVER (PARTITION BY identifiers_sessionid ORDER BY identifiers_log_time) AS next_action,
	LEAD(label) OVER (PARTITION BY identifiers_sessionid ORDER BY identifiers_log_time) AS next_label,
	LEAD(identifiers_page_name) OVER (PARTITION BY identifiers_sessionid ORDER BY identifiers_log_time) AS next_page	
  FROM eshop_data.es_events_v2
  WHERE 
  {{Date}}
  	AND nc = 'de'
    AND category <> 'addonManagement'
	AND service_line = 'fixed'
	AND internalemployee = 'no'
 AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(service_line) = lower({{servie_line}})
            OR lower(identifiers_page_category_2) = lower({{servie_line}})
        )
		AND ('All' IN ({{category}}) 
         OR category = {{category}}
         or LOWER(category) = {{category}})
	AND {{osname}} 
)
,rank_action_on_account_page as
(
SELECT
	*,
	row_number() over(partition by identifiers_sessionid order by identifiers_log_time DESC) as rn
FROM	
	events
WHERE 
	identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping'
)
,last_action_on_account_page as
(
SELECT
	*,
	concat(action,'-',label) as last_action_on_account,
	next_page as next_action_after_last
FROM
	rank_action_on_account_page
WHERE
	rn = 1
)
,agg_base as
(
	SELECT
	identifiers_sessionid,
    MAX(case when action = 'PageView' and identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' then 1 else 0 end) AS shipping_page,
	MAX(case when action = 'checkoutSubStepViewed' AND label = 'choose delivery method' and identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' then 1 else 0 end) AS choose_delivery_method,
	MAX(case when action = 'checkoutSubStepSubmitted' AND label = 'delivery - address details and speed - standard' and identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' then 1 else 0 end) AS address_details_speed,
	MAX(case when action = 'checkoutStepSubmitted' AND identifiers_page_name = 'checkout/shipping' then 1 else 0 end) AS shipping_submitted
	FROM	
		events
	GROUP BY 1
)
,dropped_session as
(
SELECT
	identifiers_sessionid,
	case 
		when shipping_submitted = 0 and address_details_speed = 1 then 'Drop at Address Deatils'
		when address_details_speed = 0 and choose_delivery_method = 1 then 'Drop at Choose Delivery - View'
		when choose_delivery_method = 0 and shipping_page = 1 then 'Drop at Shipping Page View'
		else 'Others'
		end as drop_off_step	
FROM 
	agg_base 
)
,final_base as
(
SELECT
	a.identifiers_sessionid,
	a.drop_off_step,
	b.last_action_on_account,
	b.next_action_after_last
FROM
	(select * from dropped_session where drop_off_step <> 'Others') a
LEFT JOIN last_action_on_account_page b on a.identifiers_sessionid = b.identifiers_sessionid
)
SELECT
	drop_off_step,
	COUNT(DISTINCT identifiers_sessionid) as drop_off_sessions,
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when next_action_after_last is null and lower(last_action_on_account) like '%warning%confirmation%' then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Exit due to Business error",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when next_action_after_last is null and last_action_on_account = 'errorEvent-api failure' then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Exit due to Technical error",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when next_action_after_last is null and lower(last_action_on_account) not like '%error%' then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Exit",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when next_action_after_last in ('checkout/identification','checkout/personalInfo','checkout/account') then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Back in Checkout",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when next_action_after_last in ('checkout/payment','checkout/consent','checkout/appointment','checkout/providerChange') then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Forward in Checkout",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when lower(next_action_after_last) like '%basket%' then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Switch to Basket",
	COUNT(DISTINCT case when (next_action_after_last is not null) and (lower(next_action_after_last) not like '%checkout%') 
				and (lower(next_action_after_last) not like '%basket%') then identifiers_sessionid end) as "Discovery"
FROM
	final_base
GROUP BY 1

	FROM

	final_base

    SELECT

    SUM(exitedpage) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT identifiers_sessionid) AS exit_rate
FROM session_page_level
